length_in.note: Ford.com 2026 specs table 'Length (in.)': Select 185.6, Premium 185.6, GT 187, Rally 187. (The page's FAQ answer lists 'Length: 117.5"', which is the wheelbase; not used.)

width_in.note: FAQ, 2026 Premium: 'Overall width without mirrors: 74.1"'; with mirrors 82.6".

awd.note: 'The Mustang Mach-E offers three drivetrain options: RWD, eAWD, and the GT enhanced eAWD.' eAWD available on Select and Premium; GT enhanced eAWD. C/D 2026 trims: Select RWD/AWD, Premium RWD/AWD, GT AWD. Rally appears in Ford's spec table; its drivetrain wasn't confirmed.
